'''Balinor''' was [[Warder]] to [[Verin Mathwin]]. 

== History ==
It took ten years for Verin to get over his death and bond another Warder, [[Tomas]].

==Errata==
Early printings of this book (and the audiobook) read "it had taken her ten years for her to get over Balinor's death and Bond [[Ihvon]], implying that Balinor was [[Alanna Mosvani]]'s Warder and not Verin's. This has been changed in later printings.
